title: AI Can Now Verify 100,000-Line Math Proofs—And Humans Can't Read Them!
summary: Fields Medalist Terence Tao presented findings demonstrating that AI systems can formally verify complex mathematical proofs extending over 100,000 lines. However, the breakthrough creates an epistemological crisis because the verified reasoning remains an unreadable black box to human mathematicians.
raw_text: Here's the wild part about artificial intelligence that nobody saw coming! Renowned mathematician Terence Tao just revealed at the 2026 International Congress of Mathematicians that AI has successfully verified complex mathematical proofs stretching over 100,000 lines long. That is an unbelievable technical milestone that changes mathematical research forever! Historically, humans spent months or years peer-reviewing massive theorem proofs, often missing subtle logical flaws. Now, AI can verify their mathematical validity with near-perfect certainty in seconds. But here is the crazy catch: human mathematicians literally cannot understand how the AI derived its reasoning! We are facing a bizarre scenario where a machine confirms a proof is 100% correct, but the logic is an unreadable black box. Tao pointed out that if we can't translate these machine proofs into human-readable concepts for textbooks and engineering, their practical utility is severely limited. It's an epistemological crisis: AI has outpaced human comprehension in pure mathematics, forcing us to rethink what understanding really means!

title: Urgent Alert: Malware Is Stealing Claude Cookies to Bypass MFA!
summary: Anthropic issued an urgent security bulletin warning that infostealer malware variants including Vidar and LummaC2 are hijacking browser session cookies from local endpoints. Attackers use pass-the-cookie techniques to bypass multi-factor authentication and drain paid Claude generation limits.
raw_text: So check this out—Anthropic just dropped an urgent security bulletin warning all Claude users about active attacks draining user accounts! Threat actors are deploying widespread infostealer malware like Vidar, LummaC2, and Atomic Stealer to steal active browser session cookies from your PC and Mac. Here's the wild part: because attackers are stealing already-authenticated session tokens—a classic 'pass-the-cookie' technique—they bypass your multi-factor authentication completely! Once they have that session token, they jump straight into your paid Claude account and burn through all your high-tier generation limits. Anthropic clarified that their own backend servers were not breached; the malware is infecting users' local devices directly. Anthropic has been force-logging out compromised users, revoking tokens, and refunding stolen usage, but here's the kicker: if your computer is still infected, logging back in immediately gives the hacker fresh access. You definitely need to scan your machine with reputable endpoint security tools right now and clean house before logging back in!

title: Unbreakable 3D-Printed Rubber: Scientists Create Super-Tough DNGEs!
summary: Materials scientists have engineered Double-Network Granular Elastomers (DNGEs), a 3D-printable rubber that eliminates the trade-off between fracture toughness and fatigue resistance. Test data confirms DNGEs achieve up to 15 times higher fracture toughness and three times superior fatigue resistance over standard elastomers.
raw_text: Honestly, this is huge for materials science and hardware engineering! Researchers have officially synthesized a revolutionary 3D-printable rubber called Double-Network Granular Elastomers, or DNGEs. If you follow mechanical engineering, you know materials always force a painful trade-off: if rubber is built tough to resist catastrophic tears, it fatigues quickly over repeated flexing, and vice versa. But materials scientists just shattered that barrier! By embedding rigid elastomer micro-particles inside a flexible continuous elastomer network, they created a material where mechanical strain dynamically flows across both structures instead of snapping at a weak point. The test results are mind-blowing: DNGEs deliver up to fifteen times higher fracture toughness and three times greater fatigue resistance than standard elastomers! This is a massive leap forward for soft robotics, durable prosthetic implants, aerospace seals, and wearable tech. Imagine robot grippers or artificial joints that practically never wear out. The physical world is catching up with digital design, and it's incredible!

title: Breakthrough 2D Quantum Transistor Could Slash AI Data Center Power!
summary: Researchers at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University have engineered a tunneling field-effect transistor using an ultrathin 2D bismuth/indium-selenide heterostructure. Published in Science, the device utilizes quantum tunneling instead of conventional thermal electron emission to radically improve switching energy efficiency.
raw_text: So check this out—scientists may have just discovered the holy grail of low-energy computing! Researchers over at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University just published a paper in Science detailing a breakthrough 2D quantum-tunneling field-effect transistor. Here's the wild part: traditional silicon transistors waste tons of energy and generate massive heat because they rely on thermal electron emissions. This new 2D heterostructure made of bismuth and indium-selenide uses quantum tunneling to flick electrical states on and off almost instantaneously with a fraction of the power! While this is still in the research lab and won't replace standard commercial CMOS tomorrow, it provides a viable blueprint for the future of microchips. With AI data centers currently devouring entire power grids, fundamentally altering transistor physics is the only way we will ever build super-efficient computing architectures at scale. This is fundamental science making a massive leap forward!

title: Flexible Diamond Membranes Can Now Generate Electricity From Motion!
summary: Researchers at the University of Hong Kong have demonstrated that ultrathin flexible diamond membranes exhibit a repeatable piezoelectric response. The discovery contradicts long-standing physics assumptions and enables diamond-based self-powered sensors and durable harsh-environment electronics.
raw_text: Here's the wild part about material sciences that completely defies conventional physics textbook rules! Scientists at the University of Hong Kong just proved that ultrathin, flexible diamond membranes can actually generate electricity when bent or mechanically deformed. For decades, everyone assumed diamond could never produce a piezoelectric response. But by fabricating diamond at nanoscale thickness, researchers unlocked a consistent, repeatable electrical output! Think about what this means: diamond is one of the hardest, most thermally conductive, and chemically stable materials known to humankind. By giving it piezoelectric properties, engineers can build virtually indestructible self-powered sensors, implantable medical micro-devices, and harsh-environment electronics for aerospace that never need battery replacements. Honestly, this is huge because turning the world's most resilient gemstone into an active electrical generator opens up a whole new class of perpetual micro-hardware!

title: Physicists Experimentally Prove Feynman's Quantum-Path Concept with Photons!
summary: A research team led by Shi-Liang Zhu at South China Normal University has experimentally verified Richard Feynman's foundational quantum-path concept using single-photon interference. Published in Science Advances, the findings provide empirical backing for quantum interference models used in photonic quantum computing.
raw_text: So check this out—one of the most famous theoretical concepts in the history of quantum physics was just proved in a laboratory! A physics research team led by Shi-Liang Zhu at South China Normal University just published groundbreaking research in Science Advances, successfully testing Richard Feynman's legendary path-integral concept using individual photons. For nearly a century, Feynman's path-integral formulation was treated as brilliant mathematical theory, explaining how particles explore every possible path through spacetime simultaneously. Now, researchers have actually measured and verified these quantum interference paths with precision laboratory controls. Here's the wild part: while this is pure fundamental science, mastering quantum path interference is the exact backbone needed to build next-generation photonic quantum computers and unbreakable quantum communication networks. We are taking theoretical physics diagrams and turning them into real-world quantum hardware controls. Absolutely mind-blowing stuff!
